purpose: Drives the deterministic Model-P regeneration of the Wild_LIFE SWHAP workbench (exemplar-pilot T11/T13, M1 exit gate). Single source of truth for the curatorial decisions: regen.py seeds metadata/journal.jsonl from the `decisions` and `provenance` lists below, so the ledger is a pure function of this committed file.

ratification.note: All six curatorial decisions are CURATOR-APPROVED. The provenance transitions below reach curator-approved (no longer user-provided/pending); the validator's PI-1 opt-in and the human-in-the-loop gate are thereby satisfied.

curation_timestamp.note: D4 fixed curation timestamp — ONE value for the build (committer+tagger date). Identical inputs => identical commit+tag object hashes.

decisions.summary: Exclude the 257 macOS AppleDouble resource-fork files from the curated 1.02 tree.

details.note: Excluded 256 macOS AppleDouble '._*' companion files under the wrapper plus the stray top-level sibling ._Life1.02Ultrix (257 total). Rationale: resource-fork/metadata noise from a macOS re-packaging (2010/2017 mtimes), NOT 1994 source content. The original tarball stays byte-identical in raw_materials/.

decisions.summary: Preserve the 4 author-machine absolute-target symlinks verbatim as documented broken-link artifacts.

details.note: 4 top-level symlinks (Examples, Lib, RCS, Tests) target absolute paths on the original author machine (/home/ps-home/vanroy/..., /udir/rmeyer/...), outside the extraction tree. They cannot be rewritten relative-inside (referents absent). Preserved VERBATIM as documented broken-symlink artifacts (120000 blob = the absolute target bytes; never followed, never executed).

decisions.summary: Preserve the 65 in-tree relative symlinks verbatim.

details.note: The 65 relative symlinks all resolve structurally inside the curated tree and are preserved verbatim (120000 blobs).

decisions.summary: Document (do not 'fix') the flattened 0o777 permission bits.

details.note: All regular-file permission bits are 0o777 (Ultrix/macOS extraction artifact). The builder maps the exec bit uniformly to git 100755; TF-2 collapses the exec bit for regular files, so this systematic flattening is documented, not a per-file corruption.

decisions.summary: Curator confirms publication of his real email into immutable SWH-archived history (clears PI-1).

details.note: Curator opts in to publishing roberto@dicosmo.org into immutable SWH-archived history (brief-§8 precedent). The PI-1 WARN is thereby cleared. This provenance-transition is the SOLE carrier of the opt-in (csv-contract §5.2).

decisions.summary: Accept the inferred release dates (0.90/0.91 = 1993-08-09, 1.0 = 1994-03-24, 1.02 = 1994 year-only).

0.90.evidence: CMU AI-repository listing date; tarball regfile mtimes 1992-12-08..09 predate the listing (listing date, not a per-file release date).

0.91.evidence: CMU listing date, shared with 0.90 (csv-contract §7 equal-dates case); tarball mtimes up to 1993-02-11.

1.0.evidence: CMU listing date; tarball mtimes 1994-03-18, days before the listing.

1.02.evidence: D10 (Roberto 2026-06-06): year-only 1994. Real source-file mtimes top out 1994-12-01; AppleDouble/dir mtimes (2010/2017) are repackaging artifacts, not release dates.

provenance.summary: Author identity carried as a collective label in the CSV; per-person attribution in codemeta.json + this ledger entry.

details.note: CSV carries collective label 'Wild_LIFE authors' + noreply placeholder (csv-contract §5.1). Per-person attribution: Peter Van Roy, Richard Meyer, Jean-Claude Hervé (authors); Hassan Aït-Kaci, Seth Copen Goldstein, Abder Aggoun (contributors). Real third-party addresses are NOT published in the CSV (crit-M15); recorded here and in codemeta.json.
